capabilities: Run interactive quizzes inline in reading view with scoring and instant feedback
Define quizzes as QuizPort JSON in code blocks or as .json files in the vault
Show hints before answering and explanations after answering
Review missed questions and retry only those
Export attempt history to a note
extras: Still pending review in the community plugin directory; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later for the declarative settings API. Fully offline and local, no network requests.
problem: Obsidian notes are static, so there is no way to embed an interactive, self-scoring quiz inside a note.

relations.evidence: the same file works here and on quizport.io

summary: Interactive quiz runner that renders QuizPort JSON blocks and files as clickable quizzes with scoring, hints, explanations and retries.
